pine needle javelin.desc: a dead brown pine needle. A bit bulky to wield, and too light to do proper damage.

greenwood bow.desc: a bow made from a sapling. Not very powerful, but still can be lethal.

slingshot.desc: a wooden slingshot that uses the elasticity of spider silk to shoot sharp rocks.

splinter spear.desc: a wooden splinter hardened with plant sap.

chitin spiked mace.desc: a chitin spiked mace that somewhat preserves the previous shape of an ant leg.

ant leg.desc: a limb broken off from a dead ant. It is pretty strong and could be used to swing around.

web bolas.desc: a bola made with spiderwebs. Can be thrown to entangle and swung to damage.

sharp stick.desc: a sharp stick ideal for poking.

silk robe.desc: a silk robe made from silkworm threads.

silk pants.desc: a silk pants made from silkworm threads. Very common.

leather pants.desc: a slick leather pants. Looks pretty good! +1 Health.

grass robe.desc: a grass robe made from woven grass fibers. Provides very little warmth.

long chitin jacket.desc: a long jacket crafted from the chitin of a long bodied bug. +1 Health.

chitin breastplate.desc: a plate breastplate crafted from pill bug chitin. +1 Health.

spine spear.desc: a short spear made of spine. Can be thrown.

hair ball.desc: a poisonous hair ball. Can be hurled at melee or ranged distance to poison enemies.

needle claws.desc: a claw weapon made from the legs of a millipede.

chitin claws.desc: a claw weapon made from the legs of a centipede.

bloodquito proboscis.desc: the proboscis of the dreaded bloodquito. Grants you a lifesteal attack, but is a bit unwieldy.

long proboscis.desc: the proboscis of a flying creature. Tough enough to be used as a weapon and long enough to attack from far away.

ancientquito proboscis.desc: the proboscis of an ancient variant of the dreaded bloodquito. Grants you a deadly lifesteal attack.

rose spike.desc: a rose spike. Allows you to injure the enemy.

horn axe.desc: an axe carved from the horn of the blue beetle. It's very sought after, and incredibly effective in combat.

horn mace.desc: a mace carved from the horn of the blue beetle. It's very sought after, and incredibly effective in combat. Grants you a very powerful attack.

horn bow.desc: a bow carved from the horn of the blue beetle.

chitin greave.desc: a greave crafted from pill bug chitin. +1 Health.

chitin gauntlets.desc: a pair of chitin gauntlets. Allows you to punch.

chitin shield.desc: a shield crafted from pill bug chitin. Allows you to block.

moonglow staff.desc: a staff faintly glowing with strange blue light. Allows you to gather large amounts of mana.

fishbone spear.desc: a spear carved from fish bones.

fishbone bow.desc: a bow carved from fish bones.

priest's ring.desc: a marble ring tied with human leather. It is enchanted to let you see in the dark.

Lucid's amulet.desc: a powerful magical necklace that lets you turn yourself or a volunteer into a small mouse. It is Lucid's personally valuable item. Makes you really wonder who he is.

furry foot wrap.desc: a leather foot wrapping covered with oily hair, tough enough to replace boots. Helps you free yourself from entanglement.

silver sword.desc: a silver sword that belonged to an unknown user. This rusted weapon must have been very valuable at one point.

silver spear.desc: a wooden spear with a silver tip. How the ferals came to have access to forged silver is unknown.

glowshroom bundle.desc: a glowshroom bundle. It's a nice souvenir from the feral caves.

crystal necklace.desc: A strange necklace. It shimmers when you press it. You think you can briefly stun an enemy using this artifact.

kidney staff.desc: a wooden stick with a kidney pierced at the tip. Somehow, the kidney is still fresh. Requires mana knowledge to use.

glass necklace.desc: You think you can briefly stun an enemy using this artifact.

hand crossbow.desc: a handheld mechanical bow capable of firing a strong, piercing shot. Crossbows can be used in melee.

shrapnel.desc: a collection of sharp metals that stand with the sharp edges upward, damaging and stunning anyone walking across it.

metal saw.desc: a circular metal saw covered in rust. Makes both a good ranged and melee weapon.

raptor fang.desc: a fang from a raptor. Incredibly sturdy and sharp.

wood axe.desc: a sturdy wood axe for chopping wood. Surprisingly light.

great axe.desc: a huge axe for... chopping wood? This is a pretty great axe.

fabric robe.desc: a rough fabric robe to hide your belongings.

brass sword.desc: a brass sword with steel edge. Light and sharp but fragile.

brass mace.desc: a brass mace used by the authority in Jericho.

steel sword.desc: a steel sword with steel edge. A powerful military grade weapon.

steel mace.desc: a heavy steel mace. A powerful military grade weapon.

musket.desc: a powerful weapon from Jericho. It's a long stick with a bunch of gears sticking out the shaft.

priest sigil.desc: A sigil worn by the priest of Stone Henge that contains life force.

human corpse.desc: a human corpse. Could be edible, if you are desperate enough.

bug meat.desc: a bug meat, which is the main source of food for people. You can boil, roast, grill, stir fry, or cook it over fire on a stick! Heals 3 health on rest.

bug jerky.desc: a bug jerky, the go-to ration for every hunter in Ant Hill. Heals 3 health on rest.

blood droplet.desc: a drop of blood. Leaves an unpleasant taste in your mouth, but is very fulfilling. Heals 3 health on rest. Can be used outside combat to heal 2 health instantly.
blood droplet.text: You eat the blood droplet. Mmmm, chewy!

pollen ball.desc: a ball of pollen. Makes a tasty treat! Heals 2 health on rest.

beast meat.desc: a bloody meat from endoskeletal beasts. So full of meat and so delicious.

sturdy wood.desc: a sturdy wood suitable for construction.

spellcasting manual.desc: a manual that can teach you to be an apprentice spellcaster.

ranger manual.desc: a manual that can teach you to be a ranger.

mushroom pemmican.desc: a dough of pulped glowshroom and ground human meat. Surprisingly good! Heals 4 health on rest.

healing salve.desc: a healing salve. Apply outside combat to heal 2 health immediately.

warrior manual.desc: a manual that can teach you to be a warrior.

potion of experience.desc: an incredibly valuable and mystical potion that grants you experiences that you've never had.

mysterious amulet.desc: a mysterious amulet that you don't remember having at all. Strange...

shaman manual.desc: a manual that can teach you to be a shaman.

cutthroat manual.desc: a manual that can teach you to be a cutthroat.

coin purse.desc: a purse full of coin. Use to obtain 10g.

cog system.desc: a glass box of intricate arrangement of cogwheels and other machine parts. Could be sold for money.

lottery ticket.desc: a lottery ticket. One in a million chance to win 1 million gold!

healing potion.desc: a healing potion. Apply outside combat to heal 8 health immediately.

training manual.desc: a manual that teaches you a set of moves.

coin bag.desc: a bag full of coin. Use to obtain 20g.

golden ticket.desc: a golden ticket. Use to obtain 2000g or sell for 2653g.

spider meat.desc: a spider meat. Could be edible, if you are desperate enough.

ambrosia paste.desc: an unknown paste. Doesn't taste like anything, but incredibly fulfilling.

belt of sustain.desc: a metal belt. Continuously creates food and water and places them in attached metal pockets.
